keys.effect: Scales the horizontal anchor offset of HUD elements relative to screen center. Values below 1.0 pull HUD elements inward: 0.67 creates a 21:9 safe zone and 0.50 creates a 16:9 safe zone on 32:9 displays.
keys.notes: Crucial for 32:9 and super ultrawide panels to prevent neck strain and peripheral eye fatigue. In-game Rescale HUD slider resets this value.

keys.effect: Disables the fish-eye perspective warping and radial edge blur when activating Witcher Senses.
keys.notes: Added in Next-Gen v4.0. Highly recommended for all users sensitive to motion sickness or playing on ultrawide monitors.

keys.effect: Enables or disables camera dirt and sun lens flare bursts.
keys.notes: Disabling prevents sudden high-luminance flashes and eye fatigue, especially on HDR OLED panels.

keys.effect: Multisample Anti-Aliasing (MSAA) level applied to NVIDIA HairWorks geometry.
keys.notes: The default value of 8 heavily taxes GPU rasterization at 1440p and 4K with negligible perceptual benefit. 2 provides smooth strands at significantly higher FPS.
When running fixed upscaling (DLSS Quality or DLAA), DRS should be disabled to prevent subtle resolution fluctuating and micro-stutter.
Recommended Off across all goals to eliminate motion sickness and peripheral smearing.

keys.effect: Depth of field background and focal blurring.
keys.notes: Recommended Off for eye comfort to prevent constant unnatural focal adaptation.

keys.effect: Lens color separation causing peripheral color fringing.

keys.notes: Produces tunnel-vision sensations on wide aspect ratios; recommended Off.
Provides high framerate headroom on high-resolution displays when paired with NVIDIA Reflex.

engine_overrides.behaviour: In-game Video -> HUD Configuration 'Rescale HUD' slider resets this value to default 1.0 (outer screen edges).
engine_overrides.action: Set via dx12user.settings and avoid touching the in-game Rescale HUD button.

manual_only_settings.reason: The Close camera introduces high angular velocity and rapid rotational swings on 32:9 ultrawide screens, causing motion fatigue.
Resets manual uiHorizontalFrameScale edits back to 1.0.

notes: The Witcher 3 Next-Gen (v4.0+) introduces DirectX 12 support, DLSS 3, FSR 2, Ray Tracing, and new accessibility features.
DX12 settings are stored in dx12user.settings; legacy DX11 settings are in user.settings.
At 5120x1440, uiHorizontalFrameScale=0.67 centers the HUD to 21:9 (~3413px wide), while uiHorizontalFrameScale=0.50 centers it to 16:9 (2560px wide).
